instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Wash, trim, and mince green onions. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the onion and garlic; mix until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ground turkey
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place almond meal on a plate. Using a ¼ cup measure, portion and form the turkey mixture into ½-inch thick patties and add to the plate. Dredge patties to coat, pressing gently to adhere.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cup almond meal/flour

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, adding additional oil as needed, add turkey patties and cook, turning once, until golden and almost cooked through, about 3 minutes per side. Transfer to another large baking sheet pan and place in the oven; bake until cooked through, 8-10 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a large bowl along with the oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and trim beans. Add to the bowl with the garlic oil, toss to coat, and place on a second baking sheet pan.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb green beans

instructions.primary_message: Place beans in the oven and bake until fork-tender, stirring once, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide turkey patties and beans between plates. Enjoy!

In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15-18 minutes. Transfer cooked quinoa to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in a thin layer to cool.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
3 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 small pkg fresh mint
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups edamame

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large salad bowl.
Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer both to the salad bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Trim and mince green onions; add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts and add half to the bowl (reserve the rest for garnish).
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup peanuts, roasted unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Add soy sauce, oils, and pepper to the bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup soy sauce
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve each cabbage lengthwise and cut out the core; thinly slice crosswise and add to the bowl with the dressing. Using tongs, toss cabbage with the dressing to thoroughly coat.
Add spinach, edamame, and quinoa to the bowl; toss once more to combine the salad.
Halve and pit avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with avocado and reserved peanuts. Enjoy!
Peel and mince garlic. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp oregano

instructions.primary_message: Pat the steak dry with paper towels, then slice against the grain into ¼-inch thick strips. Transfer steak to another medium bowl, pour half of the dressing over the steak, and turn to coat. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and thinly slice onions into half-moons. Transfer to the bowl with the remaining dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium red onions

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and trim cucumbers; medium dice and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ English cucumbers

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes. Roughly chop olives. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, peel and mince additional garlic. Place in a small bowl along with yogurt, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the yogurt sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 cup plain Greek yogurt
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add steak strips to the hot grill pan and cook to desired doneness, about 1 minute per side for medium-rare. Transfer to a plate.
Wash and dry lettuce; separate into leaves.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Pile lettuce leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates. Fill with Greek salad, steak, and feta. Serve with yogurt sauce on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (4 oz) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the skillet and cook, flipping once, until starting to brown, about 4 minutes (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Remove skillet from the heat and transfer chicken to a plate.
Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic and onions.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water. Set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups basmati rice

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat; add garlic, onion, rice, broth, and spices. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp cumin
1 ½ tsp turmeric
1 ½ tsp oregano
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low. Return chicken to the skillet (overlapping the chicken thighs slightly, if necessary), cover, and cook until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes.
Meanwhile, grate cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block cheddar cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place peas in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Remove skillet from the heat. Sprinkle cheese and peas over the top, and let stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
To serve, divide chicken and rice between plates and enjoy!
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 medium carrots
1 ½ bunches radish
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic and ginger; transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the garlic and ginger. Add vinegar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp fish sauce
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, remove from heat and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water.
instructions.secondary_message: 15 oz flat rice (pad thai) noodles

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pat pork chops dry with paper towels. Place in a baking dish and pour ⅓ of the dressing over the chops; turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 pork chops, boneless

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Discard marinade.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then slice crosswise into half-moons. Transfer to a large plate.
Peel and coarsely grate carrots; transfer to the plate with the cucumber.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; add to the plate.
Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; add to the plate.
Thinly slice pork chops against the grain.
To serve, divide noodles, pork, and veggies between bowls. Drizzle with remaining dressing and enjoy!
If using wooden skewers, place 18-22 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
1 ½ small pineapples
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice limes into the bowl with the garlic. Add mayo, honey, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup honey
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Place spices in another large bowl and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp cumin
½ tsp turmeric

instructions.primary_message: Cut skin off pineapples, core, and cut into bite-sized pieces; transfer to the bowl with the spice mix.

Add shrimp to the bowl with the pineapple, toss to coat, then thread shrimp and pineapple onto the skewers. Alternatively, you can cook the shrimp and pineapple directly on the grill/skillet without using skewers.
Preheat a large grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add skewers to the grill and cook, turning occasionally, until charred and the shrimp are cooked through, about 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp virgin coconut oil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice the cucumbers into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the dressing along with mixed greens; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates and top with skewers. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice parsnips; transfer to a large baking sheet pan, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to combine, then spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium parsnips
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place parsnips in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
While the parsnips are baking, peel and mince garlic; transfer to a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and grill until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Add mixed greens to the bowl with the dressing and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide steak, parsnips, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Place eggs in a large pot, cover with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
instructions.secondary_message: 9 eggs

instructions.primary_message: While the eggs are cooking, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium carrots
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Transfer to another large pot, fill about halfway with hot water (from the tap), and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, cut each cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Cut into small, bite-sized florets.
Add cauliflower to the pot with the carrots and stir to combine. Cook until veggies are crisp-tender, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the vinaigrette; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place yogurt, mayo, and spices in a large bowl; whisk to combine the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup plain Greek yogurt
¾ cup avocado oil mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place peas in a colander. When the carrots and cauliflower are done, pour into the colander over the peas. Run under cold water to cool and set aside to drain.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups frozen peas

instructions.primary_message: Drain and mince capers; add to the bowl with the creamy dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp capers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince onion; add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 medium yellow onion

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear prosciutto into small pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice eggs; add to the bowl along with the carrots, cauliflower, and peas. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide spring mix between plates and drizzle with vinaigrette. Top with cauliflower salad and enjoy!
Cut butter in small pieces, place in a small bowl, and set aside to soften.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 medium carrots
3 (8 oz) pkg sugar snap peas

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into the bowl with the butter. Cut lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the butter.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl. Mash the butter, garlic, and basil together with the back of a spoon until smooth. Set the compound butter aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: While the steak is cooking, peel, trim, and slice carrots into thin rounds.
Peel and mince additional garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrots, snap peas, salt, and pepper; stir-fry until veggies are fork-tender, 5-6 minutes. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak.
To serve, divide steak and veggies between plates. Top steak with compound butter and squeeze lemon over the veggies. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
1 ½ lb white mushrooms
1 small pkg fresh sage

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 2-inch pieces. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Slice mushrooms into ½-inch thick pieces; add to the baking sheets with the asparagus. Season veggies with salt and pepper; toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut butter into small pieces and dot over the veggies.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until the veggies are fork-tender, 15-20 minutes.
While the veggies are roasting, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add pork chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick sage leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.
Return skillet to medium-high heat and add more butter; stir constantly until the butter is melted and golden brown, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the sage.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide asparagus, mushrooms, and pork chops between plates. Top chops with sage butter and enjoy!
Wash and dry mixed greens and raspberries. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
3 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pan and grill, turning once, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup pecan halves

instructions.primary_message: Remove chicken to a cutting board and cut into strips.
Add chicken, mixed greens, and raspberries to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, crumble goat cheese over top, and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (4 oz) logs goat cheese

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash, dry, and juice lemons into a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the lemon juice, along with oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat halibut dry with paper towels, cut into portions (if necessary), and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Season with spices, then wrap 2 slices of bacon around each portion; drizzle with oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb halibut fillet
¾ tsp thyme, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
12 slices bacon
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven and roast until the fish is almost cooked through, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and thinly slice Brussels sprouts crosswise; add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb Brussels sprouts

instructions.primary_message: Finely grate Parmesan and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oz Parmesan cheese

instructions.primary_message: Add almonds to the bowl, toss to combine the salad, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ⅓ cup almonds, sliced

instructions.primary_message: When the fish is almost cooked through, change oven setting to broil on high, and continue to cook until the bacon is crisp and fish is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide halibut and Brussels sprout salad between plates. Enjoy!
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and spread it out on a large baking sheet pan to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 oranges
1 ½ limes
3 grapefruits
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice half of the oranges into a large bowl. (Set remaining oranges aside for later use.)
Juice limes into the bowl with the orange zest and juice. Add oil, honey, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp honey
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin and white pith from the remaining oranges and the grapefruits; slice into thin rounds. Add both to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb cod fillet
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add fish and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, trim, halve, and slice cucumbers crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing and citrus fruit.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Once the cod is done, use your fingers to flake the fish into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl.
Add arugula to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide cooled rice between bowls and top with cod and citrus salad. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 450°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into the bowl with the garlic, then add oil, Dijon, and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add mushrooms to the bowl with the marinade.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels, add to the bowl, and toss to coat. Transfer mushrooms and drumsticks to the baking sheets, arranging them in an even layer; drizzle any leftover marinade over top.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 ¾ lb chicken drumsticks

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning halfway through, until mushrooms and chicken are cooked through, 30-35 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place mayo, oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper in a clean large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp avocado oil mayonnaise
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and thinly slice artichokes; add to the bowl with the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Right before serving, add spinach to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken, mushrooms, and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb cremini mushrooms

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add mushrooms, veggie ground, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle flour into the skillet; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Add milk and soy sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until gravy has thickened, 3-4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 fl oz (3 cups) almond milk, unsweetened
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the oranges, then cut into wedges.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 oranges

instructions.primary_message: Toast buns if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 whole grain buns or rolls

instructions.primary_message: Divide buns between plates and top with gravy; serve with orange wedges on the side. Enjoy!
Place mayo, miso paste, vinegar, sugar, garlic powder, and pepper in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp miso paste, white
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
¾ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 sticks celery
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Drain tuna, add to the bowl, and flake with a fork. Stir to combine the tuna salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumbers crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Chop chives into small pieces.
To serve, divide cucumber slices between plates. Top each slice with a spoonful of tuna salad, then sprinkle with chives and sesame seeds. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ tsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of each zucchini to make ribbons. Place in a large bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Juice lemons into the bowl. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with Parmesan and spices. Gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!
Preheat oven to 400°F.

Wash, dry, and trim zucchini; run a vegetable peeler along the length of the zucchini to make ribbons. Divide between two baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 medium zucchini squash
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated), and bake, tossing halfway through, until zucchini is tender, 15-18 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place half in a large bowl (reserve remaining parsley for serving).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Add veggie ground, bread crumbs, eggs, and spices to the bowl with the parsley; use your hands to combine. Using a tablespoon measure, form the mixture into rounded "meatballs" and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
3 eggs
¾ tsp salt
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp nutmeg, ground
½ tsp cloves, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning often, until browned on all sides, 3-4 minutes (the meatballs will not be cooked all the way through). Transfer meatballs to a large baking dish. (Reserve skillet with drippings for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add broth, cream, soy sauce, Dijon, and salt. Whisk to combine the sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) heavy whipping cream
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Transfer sauce to the baking dish with the meatballs. Gently stir to cover meatballs with sauce.
Place baking dish in the oven and bake until meatballs are cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide zucchini noodles, meatballs, and sauce between plates. Top with remaining parsley and enjoy!
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a medium bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden and caramelized, 18-20 minutes. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Place leaves in a large pot.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Add orzo, broth, soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the pot with the thyme. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer over high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
15 oz orzo pasta
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the orzo is cooking, finely grate mozzarella. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ (8 oz) block mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: When the onions are caramelized, carefully transfer them to the pot with the orzo. Stir to combine. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Add spinach to the pot with the orzo in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Return to medium-high heat and continue to cook until spinach is completely wilted, 3-4 minutes more.
Once the spinach is wilted, remove from heat, sprinkle with grated cheese, and cover with a lid. Set aside until cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes.

Meanwhile, return skillet used for the onions to medium-high heat. Add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add bread slices and pan-fry until toasted on one side, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
6 slices sourdough bread

instructions.primary_message: Remove bread to a plate and add more butter to the skillet. Return bread to the skillet, toasted-side up, and continue to pan-fry until toasted on the other side, 1 minute more. Return to the plate.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Divide orzo between plates or bowls. Serve with toasted sourdough on the side and enjoy!
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb green beans
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, reduce to medium-low and simmer until beans are fork-tender, 1-2 minutes. Drain and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion. Divide between a medium and a large bowl. Set the medium bowl aside for later use.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Add veggie ground, eggs, bread crumbs, soy sauce, and spices to the large bowl with the onion. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Use a scant ¼-cup measure to form the veggie ground mixture into ½-inch thick fritters and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
24 oz veggie ground, plant based
3 eggs
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add fritters and pan-fry until golden and cooked through, 4-5 minutes per side. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the medium bowl with the onion (reserving a small handful for serving).
instructions.secondary_message: 1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl along with yogurt, mayo, water and spices, then stir to combine the yogurt sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp water
1 ½ tsp dill, dried
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide fritters and green beans between plates or bowls. Drizzle with yogurt sauce and sprinkle with reserved mint. Enjoy!

Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 (12 oz) pkgs extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb white mushrooms
1 ½ small bunches asparagus
1 small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Quarter mushrooms. Place in a medium bowl.
Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch long pieces. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Add leaves to the bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and medium dice onions. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ medium yellow onions

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, thyme, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth, orzo, and soy sauce to the pot; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed and orzo is desired firmness, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
48 fl oz (6 cups) chicken or vegetable broth
15 oz orzo pasta
2 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Place on a plate, then sprinkle both sides with cornstarch and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp cornstarch
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add tofu and pan-fry until golden brown and warmed through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide tofu and orzo between plates. Enjoy!
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 medium zucchini squash
2 avocados
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals (if using fresh shrimp, skip this step). Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a medium bowl. Shave leaves off the parsley stems; discard the stems, mince the leaves, and add to the bowl.
Finely chop the anchovy fillets. Add to the bowl along with mayo, capers, oil, Dijon, and salt; whisk to combine dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 anchovy fillets, packed in oil
¾ cup avocado oil mayonnaise
3 tbsp capers
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut them crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle; place in a medium bowl.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim zucchini, halve lengthwise, and cut crosswise into ¼-inch-thick half-rounds.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom, then add zucchini and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until golden brown, about 6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Remove zucchini to the bowl with the onion and return the skillet to medium-high heat. Add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches if necessary, add shrimp, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook, stirring often, until cooked through and slightly golden, about 4 minutes; remove from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados; slice crosswise while still in the skin and scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide mixed greens between plates; top with shrimp, vegetables, avocado, and dressing. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
